Name: Cute Beds CP
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
UPDATE 1.0.1: fixed the 8 beds which were missing one line of pixels due to sprite sheet error <3
UPDATE 1.1.0: ADDED 21 NEW BEDS! Walnut style wood option is now configurable in GMCM <3 
UPDATE 2.0.0 ADDED 84 NEW BEDS!  42 single beds + 42 ADORABLE Child beds!!!

Introducing Cute Beds mod!!! ◝(ᵔᵕᵔ)◜ 

[size=3]₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ I just released [url=https://youtu.be/mU9H2whIVm4]THIS youtube video[/url] showcasing all of my 'Cute' furniture so far!!! (cribs, beds, rugs) come check it out if you please!![/size][size=3]! ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊[/size]

This mod now adds 147 beds to your game. Double beds, single, and child's beds. All have the option of oak/walnut/birch. All stick to 7 colour palettes!  (configurable in GMCM if you want to use birch//oak// or both). this version is for content patcher. If you prefer alternative textures, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34249]Alternative Textures Version[/url] 

I made this because I wanted some cute options for beds that still look good with vanilla furniture, so I came up with these! I hope you're able to find one that you like! My favourite is probably "Dreamy Quilt Bed", I plan to use it in my save <3

WANT MORE CUTENESS IN YOUR GAME?
This mod compliments/ follows the same colour family as my mod called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34078]Cute Rugs[/url]. It is also availible for CP and AT. Check out the promo pics to see some of the options when pairing both of these mods together <3
﻿If you want to see what the rugs look like in the game, I've made a youtube short showcasing all 49 rugs from ^ Cute Rugs. Check it out here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/924Sy8VOg0c]youtube short Cute Rugs[/url]. I will be making a video on this bed mod soon as well ‧₊˚❀༉‧₊˚.
UPDATE: I've now added [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34389]Cute Cribs[/url] which adds 21 crib options in all 7 colours of my 'Cute' series!

How to install:
1. ensure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed
2. download my file
3. unzip the file into your 'Mods' folder
you will now have 147 options for cute beds in your game!!!

[size=3]ANY ISSUES? CRITIQUES? SUGGESTIONS? pls leave me a comment and let me know! ‧₊˚❀༉‧₊˚.

[/size][size=4]WANT TO KNOW WHAT I'M WORKING ON NEXT?
[/size]-All green version of my 'Cute' series~
-CUTE COUCHES (and then other furniture, nursery furniture etc)
-Character replacement sprite/portrait for Clint (Berserk fans will certainly enjoy)
-another frog related project is on the horizon.... 𓆏
... and SO MANY MORE THINGS, I can't wait to share them all with you <3
